    if z.shape[1] == 0:
        return values
    q, singular, _ = np.linalg.svd(z, full_matrices=False)
    if ridge == 0:

        return values - q @ (q.T @ values)
    shrink = singular**2 / (singular**2 + ridge)
    return values - q @ (shrink[:, None] * (q.T @ values))
